question: Durand line divides which two countries?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Afghanistan-Pakistan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Durand Line is the 2640-kilometer (1,640-mile) border between Afghanistan and Pakistan.
 
• It's the result of an agreement between Sir Mortimer Durand, a secretary of the British Indian government, and Abdur Rahman Khan, the emir, or ruler, of Afghanistan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Khunjerab Pass is the crossing border between China and Pakistan.
